ownerQuote: 继续推进吧, 尽量不要computeruse

decisionBasis.baseline: Installed067 ordinary share sheet fails target enumeration; same public PDF Explorer share succeeds. Normal profile environment still fails; same elevation; cross-process package transfer now proved byte-identical in background.
decisionBasis.ruledOut: Do not rewrite renderer/ASR, blame file corruption or repeat the normal-profile/elevation comparison. Independent IPC alone does not qualify system SharePicker.
decisionBasis.candidate: Follow official Microsoft desktop/UWP samples: fill request.Data synchronously from pre-resolved file; preserve Windows-owned source metadata. Use AgileReference to resolve StorageFile on callback apartment; no unsafe Send override. Per-request file preparation errors use FailWithDisplayText with save fallback.
decisionBasis.stopCondition: Keep source candidate pending until real picker/receiver path is observed; compare frozen old/current native methods before expensive product release. Do not call backend IPC a system-share fix.
